legacy_root.answer: [REDACTED] makes INDEX.json the control plane: a capability is not live until it is an immutable (package_id, version, digest) row in the index, pinned exactly in LOCKFILE.json, verified, staged, and activated. Package boundary is claimed_paths; uninstall may touch only those paths. Channels under PR-ONLY: the only write path is a pull request against the index; stable/beta are index pointers; canary is a throwaway-prefix rehearsal, not a public deploy. publish_public and mutate_in_place are REJECT from every state. Cache activation lookup is by digest; a stale D_bad cannot satisfy a D_good pin, so stale-cache-masks-a-fixed-package is unreachable. skill.council from the on-tree [REDACTED] registry is packaged end to end.

cache_invalidation.poison_policy: If cache[digest] exists but sha256(bytes)!=digest, delete and MISS. A label (package_id, version) pointing at the wrong digest is ignored for activation.
cache_invalidation.why_unreachable: A fix cannot reuse version 1.0.0 (immutability REJECT). The lockfile pin moves to 1.0.1/D_good. Activation looks up cache[D_good], which cannot HIT on D_bad. The name-keyed mutant DOES mask; that is the negative control, not the design.

expressibility.cardinality_reason: 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json and 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json are absent at repo root. Three on-tree [REDACTED] typed entries (skill.council, wf.catalog-class.discovery-only, council.preset.catalog-class.editable) are packaged instead. skills/council/SKILL.md is present but is a separate payload from the typed [REDACTED] registry entry used as the paper package.
expressibility.catalogue_claim: Every local capability arrives as an installed, versioned, lockfile-pinned package whose payload is finite static bytes with a digest and claimed_paths
expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: postinstall script that rewrites payload bytes after digest verification
expressibility.stop_reason: A postinstall rewrite would make the lockfile digest lie about running bytes and would reintroduce stale-cache-masks-a-fixed-package. The schema and VERIFYING.precondition forbid it. We stop there and do not claim the absent 96+48+64 libraries package.
expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible as an [REDACTED] package iff it has a kind in the registry schema, a canonical payload digest, claimed_paths, immutable=true, and no postinstall rewrite of bytes after verify.

file_set.notes: Canonical registry index. THIS is the control plane. Direct writes forbidden under PR-ONLY; mutation is a pull request.
Draft-07 schema for the index. Live copy: probes/[REDACTED]/registry.schema.json.
Exact (package_id, version, digest) pins. Latest-from-channel is never the running identity.
Blobs keyed by digest. Labels (id, version) are advisory and must not activate.
Activated claimed_paths after STAGING+activate. Bytes must match the lockfile digest.
Immutable release blobs. Republishing a version with a new digest is rejected.

package_unit.boundary: claimed_paths relative to install-root. Files not listed are not owned. Sibling registry entries are not claimed.
package_unit.definition: One capability (one kind, one id) is one package. The unit of install, update, rollback, and uninstall is that package.
package_unit.immutability: A version's digest cannot change. Fixes bump version and the lockfile pin.

precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: two INDEX rows for the same (package_id, version) with different digests, or two packages claiming the same path.
precedence.merge: No field-level merge of package payloads. A change is a new version. Overlay of claimed_paths across packages is forbidden.
precedence.rule: LOCKFILE pin (package_id, version, digest) is the running identity. INDEX 'latest' or channel pointer never overrides a pin. Cache never overrides a pin.
precedence.tie_break: If INDEX digest for a pinned (package_id, version) disagrees with the lockfile digest, FAIL-CLOSED (immutability violation). No mtime, no 'newer file wins'.

legacy_root.question: Specify a [REDACTED] architecture in which the canonical registry index IS the control plane and every local capability arrives as an installed, versioned, lockfile-pinned package: define the package unit and its boundary, the registry schema, release channels, the install/update/rollback state machine, and the cache-invalidation rule that prevents a stale cache from masking a fixed package.

registry_schema.cache_entry: keyed by digest; package_id/version labels are not activation keys

release_channels.binding_citation: command-center/OWNER-DECISIONS.md OQ-3: 'Release mode is PR-ONLY: propose changes as pull requests, never a private canary and never a public marketplace release.' OQ-9: a green CI install/upgrade/rollback rehearsal against a throwaway prefix stands in for the canary. Catalog owner_decisions[id=OQ-3].answer is PR-ONLY.
release_channels.canary: Not a public deployment target. OWNER-DECISIONS.md OQ-9 binds a throwaway-prefix install -> upgrade -> rollback rehearsal as the canary substitute. Channel id canary-rehearsal is that rehearsal, not a public deploy.
release_channels.promotion: A PR retargets a channel pointer in INDEX.json. No direct index write.
